compensating_controls: Single-record policy_lookup schema enforced by the policy enforcement point (BAL-3.2); at most three lookups per email (BAL-6.12); no persistent memory; cross-session lookup-volume alerting on the agent identity (BAL-7.5)
remediation_plan: None required for tailoring; re-evaluate before any change that adds retrieval, memory, bulk lookup or a new output channel (BAL-5.2)
